Purpose: Detailed implementation plan for the native production trace execution endpoint. This is a PLAN ONLY — no implementation code is written. No production trace is collected. No FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink wired. No BuildDetailedAsync called in live capture path.

PlanStatus.EndpointImplementationAllowedReason: Plan is defined and ready for review, but actual implementation requires a separate phase. No code changes are committed at this phase.

PrimaryTarget.Purpose: CLI endpoint for native production trace execution.

AuthorizationValidationTarget.Purpose: Validates all 7 authorization factors from V16.14 contract before any execution.

Classes.Name: RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor
Classes.Purpose: Static wiring point for trace sink.

GuardOrder.Check: Neither workspace nor collection in synthetic patterns list.
Output file does not already exist.

GuardOrder.IfViolated: Hard abort — these are structural invariants. Must never be violated.

DryRunBehavior.Description: When --dry-run flag is present, execute all guards but do NOT wire FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink and do NOT call BuildDetailedAsync. Output the decision that would be made (blocked/authorized) with the reason.
DryRunBehavior.OutputExample: DryRun: All guards passed. Would wire sink and execute capture with runId=<runId>. Actual execution requires --confirm-live-capture without --dry-run.

BlockedBehavior.WhenAnyGuardFails: Return LiveCaptureBlocked=true with specific blocked reason. Do NOT wire sink. Do NOT call BuildDetailedAsync. Output the blocked reason to console.

SinkLifecycle.Action: Set RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor.Current to the file sink.
Call BuildDetailedAsync ONLY after all guards pass and sink is wired.

FailureRollback.OnBuildError: Dispose sink. Restore NullSink. Delete partial trace file. Log error with runId, exception, timestamp.
FailureRollback.OnIdempotencyViolation: Return error immediately — no sink was created, nothing to roll back.
FailureRollback.OnValidationFailure: Dispose sink. Restore NullSink. Delete trace file. Mark as INVALID — do not count toward metric quality.
FailureRollback.AlwaysRestoreNote: RuntimeCandidateTraceSinkAccessor.Current MUST always be restored to NullRuntimeCandidateTraceSink after execution, regardless of success or failure.
